title: SyncVid: World-Equivariant Diffusion for Synchronized Video Generation
title_zh: SyncVid：面向同步视频生成的世界等变扩散

paragraphs.en: Generating multiple videos of a dynamic scene from a single reference video requires synthesizing both observed and unobserved content consistently across viewpoints. Existing camera-control methods for video diffusion typically rely on architectural mechanisms, including camera embeddings, cross-view attention, and geometric conditioning. Although effective for static scene content, these approaches often struggle with the fine-grained, dynamic geometry that must remain coherent across views and over time. We synchronize the diffusion process itself by sampling the Gaussian noise prior in a canonical 3D space derived from the source video and rasterizing it into target cameras, rather than sampling independently in each 2D image plane. Our method, SyncVid, lifts a monocular video into a canonical 4D representation, associates noise with scene geometry and unseen space, and rasterizes the resulting structured noise into arbitrary views. Because rendering can introduce local correlations, we further propose a cross-view-consistent whitening procedure that decorrelates neighboring pixels while preserving correspondence across views. The structured noise serves as the diffusion prior for a LoRA-adapted pretrained video diffusion model, requiring no architectural modifications. By enforcing spatiotemporal and cross-view coherence at the source of stochasticity, SyncVid generates synchronized videos and improves both perceptual quality and cross-view consistency in our experiments. Project page: https://qualcomm-ai-research.github.io/SyncVid-Webpage .

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models have rapidly matured from generating a single plausible video to supporting fine-grained user control, including camera trajectories [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . A natural extension of this control is synchronized video generation: producing multiple videos of the same dynamic scene from different viewpoints that remain consistent with one another. This capability is central to applications such as virtual reshooting and cinematography, multi-view content creation for AR/VR, and synthesizing training data for downstream 3D and 4D vision tasks. Recent work approaches this problem through camera-conditioned reshooting, self-supervised pseudo-view training, or joint multi-view denoising with cross-view interaction modules [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . These methods demonstrate that video diffusion models can produce multiple views with useful visual and geometric agreement, but rely primarily on architectural coupling, rendered conditioning, or specialized training data.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型已迅速成熟，从生成单个合理的视频发展到支持细粒度的用户控制，包括相机轨迹 [1, 2, 3]。 这种控制的自然延伸是同步视频生成：从不同视点生成同一动态场景的多个视频，并使它们彼此保持一致。 这一能力对虚拟重拍与电影摄制、面向 AR/VR 的多视角内容创作，以及为下游 3D 和 4D 视觉任务合成训练数据等应用至关重要。 近期工作通过相机条件化的重拍、自监督伪视角训练，或带跨视角交互模块的联合多视角去噪来处理这一问题 [4, 5, 6, 7, 8]。 这些方法表明，视频扩散模型能够生成具有有效视觉与几何一致性的多个视角，但它们主要依赖架构耦合、渲染条件化或专用训练数据。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of research has shown that the noise input to a video diffusion model is itself a powerful conditioning signal, rather than merely an initialization to be denoised away. Correlating noise across frames, instead of sampling it independently, improves temporal consistency and enables direct control over motion. PYoCo [ 9 ] introduces correlated noise priors for video diffusion, while How I Warped Your Noise [ 10 ] and Go-with-the-Flow [ 11 ] warp a continuous noise field according to optical flow. EquiVDM [ 12 ] further formalizes the resulting equivariance between noise transformations and generated motion. These results suggest that structured noise – noise with an explicit, non-trivial correlation structure tied to the underlying content – can serve as an effective and lightweight conditioning mechanism, complementing changes in model architecture or training data.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线表明，输入到视频扩散模型中的噪声本身就是一种强大的条件信号，而不仅仅是一个等待被去噪消除的初始化。 让噪声在帧之间相关，而不是独立采样，可以提升时间一致性，并实现对运动的直接控制。 PYoCo [ 9 ] 为视频扩散引入了相关噪声先验，而 How I Warped Your Noise [ 10 ] 和 Go-with-the-Flow [ 11 ] 则根据光流对一个连续噪声场进行扭曲。 EquiVDM [ 12 ] 进一步形式化了噪声变换与生成运动之间由此产生的等变性。 这些结果表明，结构化噪声——即具有与底层内容相关联的显式、非平凡相关结构的噪声——可以作为一种有效且轻量的条件机制，补充模型架构或训练数据方面的改进。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we show that synchronizing the diffusion prior in a canonical 3D space can induce world-equivariant video generation. Specifically, camera-induced changes in the 3D noise representation are reflected as consistent changes in the generated views. We achieve this by synchronizing the diffusion process at its source of randomness: we construct a canonical 3D noise representation that spans the reconstructed scene observed in the reference video as well as its surrounding unobserved space. We then rasterize this representation into each target camera to produce view-consistent noise priors, including for complex transformations such as out-of-plane rotations. Because all target views derive their stochastic initialization from the same canonical representation, the diffusion model is encouraged to generate correlated completions of unseen content, while conditioning on the reconstructed scene preserves consistency in observed regions. paragraphs.en: Structured noise has emerged as an effective mechanism for improving temporal consistency and controlling motion in video diffusion models. PYoCo [ 9 ] observes that when an image diffusion model is adapted into a video model, the noise injected at different frames should preserve temporal correlation rather than being independent: independent per-frame noise lets the denoiser drift toward a slightly different appearance in each frame, causing jitter and flicker, whereas correlated noise starts neighboring frames from related latent structure and denoises them into consistent appearance and smoother motion. This gain requires no new architecture—no motion modules, optical-flow supervision, or video transformers—but only a modified noise prior, so a pretrained image model reaches strong temporal consistency by fine-tuning on comparatively little video data at low cost. Later work makes the correlation explicit: How I Warped Your Noise [ 10 ] transports a continuous Gaussian noise field across frames while preserving its distribution, Go-with-the-Flow [ 11 ] warps noise by real-time optical flow to control object and camera motion, and EquiVDM [ 12 ] shows that training with warped noise encourages equivariance between noise transformations and generated motion. All build correspondence through 2D motion warping, which suits consecutive frames of a single camera, where motion is well approximated by an in-plane flow field, but does not extend across cameras: a 2D warp expresses neither out-of-plane camera rotation nor correspondence for surfaces that a different viewpoint newly reveals or occludes.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化噪声已成为在视频扩散模型中提升时间一致性并控制运动的有效机制。 PYoCo [9] 观察到，当图像扩散模型被改造为视频模型时，注入不同帧的噪声应当保持时间上的相关性，而不是彼此独立：逐帧独立的噪声会让去噪器在每一帧中漂移向略微不同的外观，导致抖动和闪烁；而相关噪声则让相邻帧从相关的潜变量结构出发，并被去噪为一致的外观与更平滑的运动。 这一收益不需要新的架构——不需要运动模块、光流监督或视频Transformer——而只需修改噪声先验，因此预训练的图像模型只需以较低成本在相对少量的视频数据上微调，即可获得很强的时间一致性。 后续工作使这种相关性更加显式：How I Warped Your Noise [10] 在跨帧传输一个连续的高斯噪声场的同时保持其分布；Go-with-the-Flow [11] 通过实时光流对噪声进行变形，以控制物体和相机运动；EquiVDM [12] 则表明，使用变形噪声进行训练可以促使噪声变换与生成运动之间形成等变性。 上述方法都通过二维运动变形建立对应关系，这适用于单个相机的连续帧，此时运动可以很好地由面内流场近似，但无法推广到多相机之间：二维变形既无法表达面外的相机旋转，也无法表达因不同视角而新显露或被遮挡表面的对应关系。

sents.zh: 结构化噪声已成为在视频扩散模型中提升时间一致性并控制运动的有效机制。

sents.en: PYoCo [ 9 ] observes that when an image diffusion model is adapted into a video model, the noise injected at different frames should preserve temporal correlation rather than being independent: independent per-frame noise lets the denoiser drift toward a slightly different appearance in each frame, causing jitter and flicker, whereas correlated noise starts neighboring frames from related latent structure and denoises them into consistent appearance and smoother motion.
sents.zh: PYoCo [9] 观察到，当图像扩散模型被改造为视频模型时，注入不同帧的噪声应当保持时间上的相关性，而不是彼此独立：逐帧独立的噪声会让去噪器在每一帧中漂移向略微不同的外观，导致抖动和闪烁；而相关噪声则让相邻帧从相关的潜变量结构出发，并被去噪为一致的外观与更平滑的运动。

sents.en: This gain requires no new architecture—no motion modules, optical-flow supervision, or video transformers—but only a modified noise prior, so a pretrained image model reaches strong temporal consistency by fine-tuning on comparatively little video data at low cost.
sents.zh: 这一收益不需要新的架构——不需要运动模块、光流监督或视频Transformer——而只需修改噪声先验，因此预训练的图像模型只需以较低成本在相对少量的视频数据上微调，即可获得很强的时间一致性。

sents.en: Later work makes the correlation explicit: How I Warped Your Noise [ 10 ] transports a continuous Gaussian noise field across frames while preserving its distribution, Go-with-the-Flow [ 11 ] warps noise by real-time optical flow to control object and camera motion, and EquiVDM [ 12 ] shows that training with warped noise encourages equivariance between noise transformations and generated motion.
sents.zh: 后续工作使这种相关性更加显式：How I Warped Your Noise [10] 在跨帧传输一个连续的高斯噪声场的同时保持其分布；Go-with-the-Flow [11] 通过实时光流对噪声进行变形，以控制物体和相机运动；EquiVDM [12] 则表明，使用变形噪声进行训练可以促使噪声变换与生成运动之间形成等变性。

sents.en: All build correspondence through 2D motion warping, which suits consecutive frames of a single camera, where motion is well approximated by an in-plane flow field, but does not extend across cameras: a 2D warp expresses neither out-of-plane camera rotation nor correspondence for surfaces that a different viewpoint newly reveals or occludes.
sents.zh: 上述方法都通过二维运动变形建立对应关系，这适用于单个相机的连续帧，此时运动可以很好地由面内流场近似，但无法推广到多相机之间：二维变形既无法表达面外的相机旋转，也无法表达因不同视角而新显露或被遮挡表面的对应关系。

paragraphs.en: Early camera-control methods such as CameraCtrl [ 1 ] , MotionCtrl [ 2 ] , and CamCo [ 3 ] condition single-view generation on camera trajectories, but do not explicitly enforce cross-view synchronization. Other methods couple denoising across views: SynCamMaster [ 6 ] adds a multi-view synchronization module for joint multi-camera generation, Collaborative Video Diffusion (CVD) [ 7 ] exchanges information through epipolar-guided cross-view attention, and CAVIA [ 8 ] uses spatial and temporal cross-attention for view consistency. A third line uses geometry as an indirect synchronization signal: ReCamMaster [ 4 ] reshoots videos along novel trajectories using video conditioning and synchronized synthetic multi-view training data, Reshoot-Anything [ 5 ] reduces dependence on paired multi-view data through self-supervised pseudo-view training around a 4D point-cloud anchor, and ViewCrafter [ 13 ] guides diffusion-based novel-view video synthesis with coarse rendered geometry. Diffusion-enhancement methods address related but different settings: ArtiFixer [ 14 ] couples video diffusion with 3D reconstruction, using opacity-aware latent mixing and autoregressive novel-view generation to enhance incomplete reconstructions, while SetDiff [ 15 ] enhances Gaussian-Splatting novel-view renderings in a multi-view setting by set-based diffusion over variable-size reference and target views grounded in pixel-aligned coordinate maps and pose-aware Plucker ray embeddings. Overall, existing methods synchronize through camera embeddings, cross-view interaction modules [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , or rendered geometric conditions [ 4 , 5 , 13 , 15 ] . In contrast, we impose camera control with structured noise: instead of sampling prior Gaussian noise independently in each camera plane, we sample a canonical 3D field and project it into each view, providing both geometric conditioning and view-consistent diffusion initialization.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的相机控制方法，如 CameraCtrl [1]、MotionCtrl [2] 和 CamCo [3]，以相机轨迹为条件进行单视角生成，但并未显式地强制跨视角同步。 另一些方法在多个视角之间耦合去噪过程：SynCamMaster [6] 增加了多视角同步模块用于多相机联合生成，协同视频扩散（CVD）[7] 通过对极引导的跨视角注意力交换信息，而 CAVIA [8] 则使用空间和时间跨注意力来保持视角一致性。 第三类方法将几何作为间接的同步信号：ReCamMaster [4] 利用视频条件和同步的合成多视角训练数据，沿新轨迹重新拍摄视频；Reshoot-Anything [5] 通过围绕 4D 点云锚点的自监督伪视角训练，降低了对成对多视角数据的依赖；ViewCrafter [13] 则用粗略渲染的几何引导基于扩散的新视角视频合成。 扩散增强方法处理相关但不同的场景：ArtiFixer [14] 将视频扩散与 3D 重建相结合，使用不透明度感知的隐空间混合和自回归新视角生成来增强不完整的重建结果；而 SetDiff [15] 则在多视角设置下增强高斯泼溅的新视角渲染，其方法是在像素对齐的坐标图和位姿感知的 Plucker 光线嵌入的基础上，对大小可变的参考视角和目标视角进行基于集合的扩散。 总体而言，现有方法通过相机嵌入、跨视角交互模块 [6,7,8] 或渲染的几何条件 [4,5,13,15] 来实现同步。 与之相反，我们通过结构化噪声来施加相机控制：不再在每个相机平面上独立采样先验高斯噪声，而是采样一个规范的三维场并将其投影到每个视角中，从而同时提供几何条件约束和视角一致的扩散初始化。

paragraphs.en: Because real-world datasets rarely provide synchronized videos of dynamic scenes, we train on synthetic dynamic videos and real-world static videos. For synthetic training, we use 36K video pairs from MultiCamVideo (MCV), introduced by ReCamMaster [ 4 ] , which provides synchronized videos and camera trajectories rendered from dynamic scenes in Unreal Engine 5. paragraphs.en: DL3DV contains monocular videos of static scenes rather than synchronized multi-view captures, so we construct pseudo-synchronized pairs via temporal folding, following CVD [ 7 ] . For each 2 ​ l − 1 2l-1 -frame clip, we split at the center frame ( l + 1 l+1 ) and reverse the first segment, yielding two segments that share their starting frame and then follow different temporal trajectories. Since the scenes are static, this reversal is physically valid, and each folded pair provides two temporally aligned observations of the same scene along distinct trajectories, with separate associated camera poses. Applying this procedure to the first two buckets of DL3DV yields about 13.5K video pairs.
paragraphs.zh: DL3DV 包含的是静态场景的单目视频，而非同步的多视角采集，因此我们参照 CVD [7]，通过时间折叠构建伪同步的视频对。 对于每个 2​l−1 帧的片段，我们在中心帧（l+1）处切分并反转前一段，得到两个共享起始帧、随后沿不同时间轨迹演进的片段。 由于场景是静态的，这种反转在物理上是有效的，并且每个折叠后的视频对提供了沿不同轨迹对同一场景的两次时间上对齐的观测，且各自带有相应的相机位姿。 将该流程应用于 DL3DV 的前两个 bucket，可得到约 13.5K 个视频对。

paragraphs.en: Multi-ViewBench. For evaluation on real-world videos we curate Multi-ViewBench , a 200-clip benchmark drawn from the Mixkit subset of Open-Sora-Plan [ 20 ] . Because reshooting a real video admits no ground-truth target view, the composition of such a set is easy to bias by hand and hard for others to reproduce, so we select it automatically: a vision-language model judges every candidate clip once against six fixed admissibility gates and four semantic attributes, and every subsequent decision is a deterministic function of those recorded judgements. Admissible clips must be a single continuous real-time shot, landscape, and captured by a physically moving camera; survivors are ranked by a richness index rewarding depth layering, occlusion, and non-rigid motion. We report two disjoint splits of 100 clips each, defined by the model’s composition judgement: standard holds the richest single-subject scenes, and complex the richest multi-subject scenes with cluttered geometry, drawn from a category-balanced pool so that no Mixkit category monopolizes the candidates. The complex split is the harder of the two by construction, with a mean richness of 71.2 against 30.9 for standard. We release the code, the per-clip judgements, and the frozen split CSVs; Sec. A.1 documents the pipeline, the per-stage counts, and its limitations in full.
paragraphs.zh: Multi-ViewBench。 为了在真实世界视频上进行评估，我们策划了 Multi-ViewBench，一个包含 200 个片段的基准，其素材来自 Open-Sora-Plan [20] 的 Mixkit 子集。 由于对真实视频重新拍摄无法得到目标视角的真值，这类数据集的构成容易被人工偏向、且他人难以复现，因此我们采用自动化筛选：一个视觉-语言模型对每个候选片段依据六个固定的准入门槛和四个语义属性各评判一次，此后的每一个决定都是这些已记录评判的确定性函数。 可入选的片段必须是单个连续的实时镜头、横幅画面、且由物理移动的相机拍摄；通过筛选的片段按一个丰富度指数排序，该指数奖励深度分层、遮挡和非刚性运动。 我们报告两个互不重叠的各含 100 个片段的划分，由模型的构图评判定义：standard 划分保存最丰富的单主体场景，complex 划分保存具有杂乱几何结构的最丰富的多主体场景，二者均取自类别均衡的候选池，从而没有哪个 Mixkit 类别能垄断候选片段。 complex 划分在构造上就是两者中更难的那个，其平均丰富度为 71.2，而 standard 为 30.9。 我们发布了代码、每个片段的评判结果以及冻结的划分 CSV 文件；第 A.1 节完整记录了该流程、各阶段的数量统计及其局限性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate cross-view synchronization, visual quality, camera accuracy, and perceptual consistency. Synchronization uses high-confidence matched pixels in corresponding regions (Mat. Pix.), cross-view FVD (FVD-V), and cross-view CLIP similarity (CLIP-V). Temporal consistency uses frame consistency (CLIP-F); following ReCamMaster [ 4 ] , camera accuracy is measured by rotation and translation errors (RotErr/TransErr) between the conditioning and recovered trajectories. We also report six no-reference VBench [ 21 ] scores for aesthetic and imaging quality, temporal flickering and motion smoothness, and subject/background consistency. Finally, a blind pairwise study presents the source and two methods’ renderings of the same target trajectory in randomized left/right order; participants select the better result or no preference, covering 50 / 200 comparisons on two disjoint sets of 25 Multi-ViewBench scenes (SyncVid vs. Artifixer and SyncVid vs. Reshoot-Anything).

paragraphs.en: Following the evaluation protocol of ReCamMaster [ 4 ] , we compare SyncVid with recent state-of-the-art methods on the real-world Multi-ViewBench test set. Table 1 shows that our method provides the strongest overall cross-view synchronization. It achieves the highest number of matched pixels in dynamic regions (1,332) and the second-highest number in static regions (1,834), behind Reshoot-Anything. It also obtains the lowest cross-view FVD (146.99) and the highest cross-view CLIP similarity (91.66), indicating that its generated views are both perceptually aligned and visually similar. In addition, it achieves the highest temporal-consistency score (CLIP-F = 97.87). Camera accuracy is not its main advantage: ArtiFixer obtains the lowest rotation and translation errors, while our method remains competitive.

paragraphs.en: We presented SyncVid, a framework for synchronized novel-view video generation that coordinates diffusion at the source of its stochasticity. By attaching persistent noise to a canonical 4D representation and rasterizing it into target cameras, SyncVid turns scene correspondence into a property of the diffusion prior rather than a responsibility of image-plane warping or additional cross-view architecture. A view-consistent whitening step keeps this structured prior compatible with the distribution expected by the pretrained model, allowing the approach to be integrated through lightweight adaptation without modifying the diffusion backbone. These findings suggest that synchronized generation can benefit from treating noise as a world-level representation: the same stochastic ingredients can follow content across viewpoints and time while leaving the model free to synthesize newly revealed regions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SyncVid，一个用于同步新视角视频生成的框架，它在随机性的源头对扩散过程进行协调。 通过将持久噪声附加到规范化的 4D 表示上并将其光栅化到目标相机，SyncVid 把场景对应关系变成了扩散先验本身的属性，而无需依赖图像平面上的扭曲或额外的跨视角架构来承担这一职责。 一个视角一致的白化步骤使这种结构化先验与预训练模型所期望的分布保持兼容，从而让该方法能够通过轻量级适配进行集成，而无需修改扩散主干网络。 这些发现表明，同步生成可以从将噪声视为一种世界级表示中获益：同一组随机成分可以跨越视角和时间跟随内容，同时让模型自由地合成新显露的区域。

paragraphs.en: Reshooting a real video admits no ground-truth target view, so the only thing a real-world benchmark can measure is behavior on the clips it happens to contain. That makes the composition of the test set part of the result. A set assembled by hand can flatter a method through nothing more than which scenes its author found compelling, and it cannot be reproduced by anyone else. We therefore built Multi-ViewBench, the 200-clip evaluation set used in Sec. 4.3 , so that every accept or reject decision is either a recorded model judgement or a deterministic function of recorded judgements. No clip was ever chosen, dropped, or reordered by inspection.

paragraphs.en: The pipeline has two stages. Stage 1 asks a vision-language model to judge each candidate clip once and writes the judgement to disk. Stage 2 never calls a model again: it filters, de-duplicates, and ranks using only the fields Stage 1 already recorded, so the entire path from corpus to final CSV can be replayed offline from the released judgements.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程包含两个阶段。 阶段 1 让一个视觉语言模型对每个候选片段判定一次，并将判定结果写入磁盘。 阶段 2 从不再调用模型：它仅使用阶段 1 已经记录的字段进行过滤、去重和排序，因此从语料库到最终 CSV 的整个路径都可以基于已发布的判定结果离线重放。

paragraphs.en: Candidates come from the Mixkit subset of Open-Sora-Plan v1.1.0 [ 20 ] , which contains 9,194 stock-footage .mp4 clips filed under 40 topical category folders ( forest , Street , Couple , Bicycle , and so on). Two properties of this corpus shape the pipeline. First, the category folders are editorial tags rather than a partition: the same physical clip is frequently filed under several categories, so the corpus contains substantially fewer distinct videos than files. Second, the clips are heterogeneous in exactly the ways that matter for camera-controlled generation, mixing locked-off tripod shots, time-lapses, portrait-orientation footage, and heavy optical effects with the moving-camera material we actually want.

sents.zh: 该语料库的两个特性决定了流水线的设计。

sents.en: First, the category folders are editorial tags rather than a partition: the same physical clip is frequently filed under several categories, so the corpus contains substantially fewer distinct videos than files.
sents.zh: 第一，类别文件夹是编辑标签而非一种划分：同一个物理片段常常被归入多个类别，因此语料库中不同视频的数量远少于文件数量。

sents.en: Second, the clips are heterogeneous in exactly the ways that matter for camera-controlled generation, mixing locked-off tripod shots, time-lapses, portrait-orientation footage, and heavy optical effects with the moving-camera material we actually want.
sents.zh: 第二，这些片段恰恰在影响相机控制生成的关键方面呈现出异质性，混合了固定机位的三脚架镜头、延时摄影、竖屏素材以及浓重的光学特效，而我们真正想要的只是运动相机机位的素材。

paragraphs.en: Each clip is judged independently by Gemini 3.1 Pro ( gemini-3.1-pro-preview ), accessed through an OpenAI-compatible inference gateway. We sample 12 uniformly spaced frames per clip, rescale each so its longest side is at most 512 pixels, JPEG-encode them, and submit the sequence with a fixed system prompt at temperature 0.2. The response is constrained to a JSON schema, so the model cannot answer in prose or omit a field, and every reply is machine-readable without parsing heuristics. One JSON file is written per clip, which makes the pass resumable: an interrupted run skips clips whose output already exists.
paragraphs.zh: 每个视频片段由 Gemini 3.1 Pro（gemini-3.1-pro-preview）独立评判，该模型通过兼容 OpenAI 的推理网关访问。 我们对每个片段均匀采样 12 帧，对每一帧进行缩放使其最长边不超过 512 像素，然后进行 JPEG 编码，并以固定的系统提示词在温度 0.2 下提交该帧序列。 响应被约束为 JSON 模式，因此模型无法以散文形式回答或遗漏字段，每条回复都无需启发式解析即可被机器读取。 每个片段写入一个 JSON 文件，这使得该流程可以断点续传：中断的运行会跳过输出已存在的片段。

paragraphs.en: The schema, summarized in Table 5 , has four parts. Six boolean gates encode hard admissibility requirements. A composition bucket assigns the clip to simple or complex and is the field that later defines our two splits: simple denotes a single subject under smooth tracking against a clean background, and complex denotes multiple subjects, cluttered environments, distinct depth layers, or dynamic backgrounds. Four semantic scores rate the properties that make a clip informative for view synthesis. Finally, three free-text reasoning fields record why the model answered as it did; these are released, and Stage 2 consults them in exactly one narrow place (Sec. A.1.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该模式（schema）总结在表5中，包含四个部分。 六个布尔门控用于编码硬性准入要求。 组成类别桶（composition bucket）将片段归类为简单或复杂，是后续定义我们两个数据集划分的字段：简单指在干净背景下、对单一主体进行平滑跟踪，复杂则指多个主体、杂乱环境、明显的深度层次或动态背景。 四个语义分数对使片段对视图合成具有信息量的属性进行评分。 最后，三个自由文本推理字段记录模型为何如此作答；这些字段已发布，且阶段2仅在一处极有限的场景中使用它们（见A.1.4节）。

paragraphs.en: Gates decide admissibility, but among admissible clips we still need an ordering, and we want it to prefer clips that actually exercise synchronized generation. A clip is informative to the degree that it has depth to be parallaxed, geometry that occludes and disoccludes as the viewpoint moves, a camera that moves at all, and subjects that deform rather than translate rigidly. We combine the four semantic scores into a single richness index
paragraphs.zh: 门控决定片段是否可采纳，但在可采纳的片段中，我们仍需要一个排序，并且希望这个排序能优先选择真正运用了同步生成的片段。 一个片段的信息量取决于：它是否具有可产生视差的深度、是否存在随视角移动而遮挡和去遮挡的几何结构、相机是否有任何移动，以及主体是否发生形变而非刚体平移。 我们将这四个语义分数合并为一个单一的内容丰富度指标。

paragraphs.en: Landscape. We probe each survivor with a video decoder and keep clips whose frame width exceeds their height, discarding portrait and square footage that no baseline is trained to reshoot. paragraphs.en: De-duplication. Because one clip may be filed under several categories, Stage 1 scored each copy independently, and copies routinely disagree with one another. We collapse to one row per unique file name, keeping the highest-richness copy and breaking ties deterministically on (category, judgement filename) so the outcome does not depend on directory iteration order. The discarded copies’ categories are preserved in an alias_categories field rather than thrown away.
paragraphs.zh: 去重。 由于同一个剪辑片段可能被归档到多个类别下，阶段 1 会对每个副本独立打分，而这些副本之间经常出现不一致。 我们将结果折叠为每个唯一文件名一行，保留内容最丰富的副本，并在（类别，判断文件名）上按确定性规则打破平局，从而结果不依赖目录的遍历顺序。 被丢弃副本的类别会保留在 alias_categories 字段中，而不是直接丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Static-source removal. A clip whose camera body never moves gives a camera-controlled model no viewpoint baseline to reshoot from, so we keep only physically moving cameras. The camera_motion label carries this directly for static and dynamic . The optical-effect labels are genuinely ambiguous, since a rack focus or lens flare is usually captured on a locked-off tripod but occasionally accompanies a real dolly move. This is the one place where the reasoning text is consulted: a regular expression looks for explicit camera-body motion (pan, tilt, track, dolly, handheld) to adjudicate the optical-effect clips, and to demote the rare dynamic clip whose own justification states the camera is stationary. The text is never used to overrule an unambiguous label.
paragraphs.zh: 静态源剔除。 对于摄影机主体从不移动的片段，受控于摄影机的模型没有可用于重拍的视点基准，因此我们只保留物理上移动的摄影机。 camera_motion 标签直接承载了静态与动态的这一信息。 光学效果标签确实存在歧义，因为变焦或镜头光晕通常是在锁定的三脚架上拍摄的，但偶尔也会伴随真实的移动摄影（dolly）运动。 这是唯一需要参考推理文本的地方：正则表达式查找明确的摄影机主体运动（摇摄、俯仰、跟踪、移动摄影、手持）来裁决光学效果片段，并对那些自身理由中说明摄影机静止的少数动态片段进行降级。 该文本从不用于推翻明确的标签。

paragraphs.en: De-duplication runs after the gates so that a copy which fails a gate can never win the richness comparison and readmit a clip that should have been rejected. It runs before static-source classification so that each physical clip receives exactly one verdict. Were the order reversed, a clip could enter the pool through whichever of its category copies happened to be scored most favorably, which would let editorial filing decisions leak into the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 去重在门控之后运行，这样未通过门控的副本就不可能在丰富度比较中胜出，从而让本应被拒绝的片段重新进入。 它在静态来源分类之前运行，以便每个物理片段恰好获得一个判定结果。 如果顺序颠倒，片段可能通过其类别副本中评分最有利的那一个进入池中，这会让编辑归档决策泄露到基准测试中。

paragraphs.en: Complex (100 clips). A pure richness sort over 1,823 complex clips collapses onto whichever categories are largest, and the supply is severely skewed (150 clips for forest against 1 for Cats ). We therefore construct this split in two steps. First we select a category-balanced set of 1,000 clips in which balance is a hard constraint and richness is maximized only within it. Because an equal quota of 1000 / 40 = 25 1000/40=25 per category is unavailable from most categories, we allocate quotas by max-min fair water-filling: give every category the same quota, let categories that cannot meet it contribute everything they have, and redistribute the shortfall equally among categories that still have supply, repeating until the budget is spent. This maximizes the smallest category’s share, then the next smallest, and degenerates to an equal split when supply permits. Each category then contributes its own richest clips up to its quota, so balance is never traded for richness. The resulting 1,000 clips span all 40 categories with between 1 and 38 clips each, a mean of 25.0, and a normalized category entropy of 0.940 against a maximum of 1. Second, we take the 100 highest-richness clips from this balanced set to form the released split.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂（100 个片段）。 对 1,823 个复杂片段进行纯粹的丰富度排序，会坍缩到数量最大的那些类别上，且供给严重偏斜（forest 类有 150 个片段，而 Cats 类只有 1 个）。 因此，我们分两步构建这一划分。 首先，我们选取一个类别均衡的 1,000 个片段的集合，其中均衡是硬约束，丰富度仅在该约束内最大化。 由于多数类别无法提供每类 1000/40=25 个片段的均等配额，我们通过最大-最小公平的注水法分配配额：先给每个类别相同的配额，无法满足的类别贡献其全部数量，再将缺口平均重新分配给仍有剩余的类别，如此重复直至预算用尽。 这样能最大化最小类别的份额，其次是最小的下一类别，并在供给允许时退化为均等划分。 随后每个类别在其配额内贡献自己最丰富的片段，因此均衡从不为丰富度让步。 最终的 1,000 个片段覆盖全部 40 个类别，每类 1 到 38 个片段不等，均值为 25.0，归一化类别熵为 0.940（最大值为 1）。 其次，我们从这一均衡集合中取出丰富度最高的 100 个片段，构成发布的划分。

paragraphs.en: The two-step construction is worth stating plainly, because balance and richness pull against each other and the second step partially undoes the first. Balancing at 1,000 determines which clips are available to be ranked, preventing the fat categories from monopolizing the candidate set; truncating to the richest 100 then concentrates on 19 of the 40 categories. What balance buys is that the final 100 is drawn from a category-fair pool rather than from a raw richness sort over the whole corpus, not that the final 100 is itself uniform over categories.
paragraphs.zh: 这两步构建方法值得直白地说明，因为均衡性与丰富度相互拉扯，而第二步会部分抵消第一步的效果。 在 1,000 条层面做均衡决定了哪些片段可以被排序，防止大类垄断候选集；随后截取最丰富的 100 条，则集中在 40 个类别中的 19 个上。 均衡所换来的是，最终的 100 条取自一个类别公平的池子，而不是对整个语料库按原始丰富度直接排序的结果，但这并不意味着最终的 100 条本身在各类别上是均匀分布的。

paragraphs.en: Since OpenSora sources are handheld or drone footage whose camera keeps moving throughout the clip, anchoring Δ t \Delta_{t} to a fixed world pose would let the novel and source views drift apart in content over the clip; composing it on the current source pose instead keeps the novel view co-moving with the source, offset from it by a structured, time-varying amount. Every Δ t \Delta_{t} is the identity at t = 0 t=0 , so each synthesized trajectory has aligned initial pose with the source trajectory and diverges from it over the clip. We synthesize six trajectory families this way, illustrated schematically in Fig. 3 :
paragraphs.zh: 由于 OpenSora 的素材是手持或无人机拍摄的片段，相机在整个片段中持续移动，如果将 Δ t \Delta_{t} 锚定到一个固定的世界位姿，新视角与源视角的内容会随片段推移而逐渐偏离；改为在当前源位姿上进行组合，则能让新视角与源视角同步移动，仅以一个结构化的、随时间变化的偏移量与其相差。 每个 Δ t \Delta_{t} 在 t = 0 t=0 时都是恒等变换，因此每条合成轨迹都与源轨迹具有一致的初始位姿，并在片段过程中逐渐偏离。 我们以这种方式合成了六类轨迹族，其示意结构如图 3 所示：

paragraphs.en: Arc left/right sweep Δ t \Delta_{t} ’s rotation up to 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} about the source camera’s local down axis, pivoting around a point a distance d d ahead of the camera.

paragraphs.en: This proposition addresses only the decorrelation induced by the canonical-position-dependent projection field. It does not establish exact whitening of the complete rasterized noise field, since shared primitives, occlusion-boundary blending, and visibility changes can preserve residual correlations. It also does not model correspondence errors in unobserved regions caused by the finite background proxy. Finally, Assumption 1 is an idealization: it treats the projection bases induced by distinct canonical positions as independent Haar-random subspaces, whereas in the actual method they are deterministic functions of the fixed frequencies 𝝎 a \bm{\omega}_{a} , phases ϕ a , c \phi_{a,c} , and scale s s . The quality of this approximation therefore depends on the separation of canonical positions relative to the frequencies used by the projection field. Empirically, we found that H=128 works fine and we keep it constant through all the experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 该命题仅涉及由规范位置相关的投影场引起的去相关性。 它并未建立对完整栅格化噪声场的精确白化，因为共享图元、遮挡边界混合以及可见性变化可能保留残余相关性。 它也未对由有限背景代理在未观测区域中引起的对应误差进行建模。 最后，假设 1 是一种理想化：它将由不同规范位置诱导的投影基视为相互独立的 Haar 随机子空间，而在实际方法中，它们是固定频率 𝝎 a \bm{\omega}_{a} 、相位 ϕ a , c \phi_{a,c} 和尺度 s s 的确定性函数。 因此，该近似的质量取决于规范位置相对于投影场所用频率的间隔程度。 经验上，我们发现 H=128 效果良好，并在所有实验中保持其恒定不变。

paragraphs.en: Sec. 3.3 claims that two cameras observing the same 3D content receive the same rasterized noise because both rasterize the same canonical anchor. We prove this exactly, for arbitrary pairs of camera poses – not only the pure-rotation special case – and for the general 4D (dynamic) setting, where a deformation module has already produced the time-dependent Gaussian parameters. In 4D Gaussian Splatting this result applies independently at each timestamp, after the deformation module has produced the time-dependent parameters of the 3D Gaussian primitives; we therefore fix a single timestamp t t throughout and do not address temporal consistency here (that is a separate claim, discussed qualitatively in Sec. 3.4 ).

paragraphs.en: Two points on scope. (i) Where Assumption 2 fails: at genuine multi-primitive blending – most notably a pixel straddling an occlusion boundary – 𝐗 p \mathbf{X}_{p} averages the anchors of unrelated surfaces (Eq. 13 ), so the clean collapse to 𝐩 0 \mathbf{p}_{0} in the proof no longer holds exactly; this is the same exception already noted in Sec. 3.4 and in Prop. 1 ’s remark. (ii) Locus of the guarantee: as with Props. 1 , this is a statement about the noise construction , exact under Assumption 2 ; it does not by itself imply the trained diffusion model’s generated frames inherit this consistency, which is what the view-synchronization metrics of Sec. 4.2 test empirically.
paragraphs.zh: 关于适用范围的两点说明。 （i）假设 2 失效之处：在真正的多图元混合处——最典型的是一个像素跨越遮挡边界——𝐗_{p} 会对来自无关表面的锚点取平均（式 13），因此证明中到 𝐩_{0} 的干净坍缩不再精确成立；这正是第 3.4 节以及命题 1 的备注中已经指出的同一例外。 （ii）保证的适用层面：与命题 1 一样，这是关于噪声构造的陈述，在假设 2 下精确成立；它本身并不意味着训练好的扩散模型所生成的帧会继承这种一致性，而第 4.2 节的视角同步指标正是对这一点进行实证检验。

paragraphs.en: 4D representation. We use an off-the-shelf feed-forward Gaussian Splatting model, NoPo4D [ 16 ] , which avoids per-video reconstruction optimization and produces dynamic primitives that are active over finite temporal windows. Each primitive has a time-varying center, covariance, opacity, and appearance, together with a time-invariant canonical anchor. To render noise for views not covered by the source video, we model unobserved background regions with an enclosing cubemap: a finite, axis-aligned box centered at the centroid of the canonical anchors, with a half-extent set to a fixed multiple of the reconstructed scene extent. The cubemap therefore lies at a depth comparable to the scene rather than at infinity, as in an environment map. We index background texels by the ray–box intersection point instead of ray direction alone, allowing pixels that observe the same proxy surface to share a canonical location. The cubemap has six square faces, each containing S × S S\times S texels with d d channels; we use S = 1024 S=1024 and d = 3 d=3 .
paragraphs.zh: 4D 表示。 我们使用一个现成的前馈式高斯泼溅模型 NoPo4D [ 16 ]，它避免了逐视频的重建优化，并能生成在有限时间窗口内活跃的动态基元。 每个基元具有随时间变化的中心、协方差、不透明度和外观，以及一个不随时间变化的规范锚点。 为了为源视频未覆盖的视角渲染噪声，我们用一个包围立方体贴图来建模未被观测到的背景区域：一个以规范锚点的质心为中心的有限、轴对齐的长方体，其半边长设为重建场景尺度的固定倍数。 因此，该立方体贴图位于与场景相当的深度处，而不是像环境贴图那样位于无穷远处。 我们通过射线与长方体的交点而非仅凭射线方向来索引背景纹素，使观察到同一代理表面的像素能够共享一个规范位置。 该立方体贴图有六个正方形面，每个面包含 S × S S\times S 个具有 d d 个通道的纹素；我们使用 S = 1024 S=1024 和 d = 3 d=3 。

paragraphs.en: Although SyncVid is trained with varied errors in the 4D noise representation and is therefore less sensitive to reconstruction quality—the 4D representation is used primarily to rasterize a synchronized noise prior—it remains limited by the quality of the monocular reconstruction. Errors in geometry, tracking, or primitive re-instantiation can still appear as subject deformation or temporal drift, while disoccluded regions are only weakly constrained and may be hallucinated by the diffusion model. Figure 7 illustrates these failure modes: the Arc-right example exhibits severe foreground inconsistencies, whereas the Dolly-out example retains the main subject and setting but introduces unrealistic content in newly exposed regions.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 SyncVid 在 4D 噪声表示中以多种误差进行训练，因此对重建质量不那么敏感——4D 表示主要用于光栅化同步的噪声先验——它仍然受到单目重建质量的限制。 几何、跟踪或基元重新实例化中的误差仍可能表现为主体形变或时间漂移，而被遮挡区域重新露出的部分仅受到弱约束，可能被扩散模型幻觉生成。 图 7 展示了这些失败模式：Arc-right 示例表现出严重的前景不一致，而 Dolly-out 示例虽然保留了主体和场景，但在新露出的区域中引入了不真实的内容。

paragraphs.en: Although SyncVid excels on video-synchronization metrics and in preserving dynamic regions in the generated videos, it does not outperform state-of-the-art methods in camera-pose estimation; methods such as ArtiFixer perform well on this task. We speculate that this gap is partly due to the absence of explicit camera-pose conditioning, such as the Plücker embeddings used by ArtiFixer. Providing this additional conditioning could improve pose accuracy, but integrating it is orthogonal to the structured-noise formulation presented here and is left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 SyncVid 在视频同步指标以及保留生成视频中的动态区域方面表现出色，但它在相机位姿估计方面并未超越最先进的方法；ArtiFixer 等方法在此任务上表现良好。 我们推测，这一差距部分归因于缺少显式的相机位姿条件，例如 ArtiFixer 所使用的 Plücker 嵌入。 提供这种额外的条件信息可以提升位姿精度，但将其集成进来与本文提出的结构化噪声公式是正交的，因此留作未来工作。
